  const times = [0, 160, 340, 500, 680, 840, 1020, 1180, duration];
  const number = /-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?/g;

  const wingPoses = {
    "wing-left-shape": [
      "M9 82 C23 78 30 90 39 84 54 75 70 76 67 96 63 115 48 134 32 137 17 141 7 134 6 122 4 111 4 94 9 82Z",
      "M46 107 C55 100 72 102 78 111 86 122 83 142 75 155 70 168 60 173 49 170 38 167 33 159 34 147 34 131 38 116 46 107Z",
      "M16 113 C25 104 35 113 42 107 57 94 68 91 64 112 61 133 49 156 36 166 24 173 14 165 12 153 10 141 11 124 16 113Z",
      "M16 108 C26 100 35 107 44 101 57 91 71 87 67 109 63 129 50 150 39 158 26 166 16 159 15 148 13 136 12 119 16 108Z",
      "M49 98 C59 92 74 95 80 105 87 117 85 135 78 149 73 160 63 167 51 164 40 162 34 152 34 140 34 124 41 107 49 98Z",
      "M12 95 C23 89 31 98 40 93 53 84 68 82 65 101 61 123 50 140 35 151 22 158 12 151 9 140 6 125 7 107 12 95Z",
      "M37 119 C47 112 62 113 69 122 77 134 76 150 70 163 64 176 54 182 44 178 34 175 28 167 29 155 29 140 32 127 37 119Z"
    ],
    "wing-right-shape": [
      "M150 105 C157 95 172 90 181 87 193 86 205 105 211 120 217 138 208 153 194 159 183 165 170 160 161 153 152 146 146 135 146 123 145 116 146 110 150 105Z",
      "M197 101 C202 93 213 91 219 100 226 109 230 121 232 133 235 145 228 154 216 157 207 162 199 158 194 151 189 142 190 129 190 119 190 111 193 105 197 101Z",
      "M174 130 C180 121 196 112 205 113 214 115 220 130 221 144 224 157 220 174 208 183 199 189 187 186 179 180 169 173 165 159 167 147 168 139 170 133 174 130Z",
      "M160 117 C167 109 183 104 193 103 205 104 216 119 220 132 225 145 221 158 210 167 200 176 187 176 176 171 165 166 157 153 156 141 155 132 156 123 160 117Z",
      "M196 101 C201 93 212 91 219 100 225 109 229 121 231 133 233 145 227 153 215 157 206 161 197 157 193 150 188 141 190 129 189 119 189 111 192 105 196 101Z",
      "M158 118 C165 109 179 105 191 105 203 106 211 121 214 133 219 150 214 165 202 173 192 179 180 178 170 172 160 166 152 155 151 144 150 134 153 124 158 118Z",
      "M192 118 C199 110 212 109 219 116 226 124 230 137 232 147 235 159 229 169 218 175 208 180 196 176 189 170 182 162 181 149 183 138 184 129 188 122 192 118Z"
    ],
    "hand-left-shape": [
      "M7 80 C5 73 4 66 7 61 11 57 16 54 20 56 26 58 26 68 28 76 L29 94 C26 98 20 96 15 92 11 90 8 85 7 80Z",
      "M40 112 C38 104 44 95 50 90 57 85 63 87 69 92 75 98 78 106 79 113 L78 124 C73 128 64 124 57 122 50 120 43 117 40 112Z",
      "M12 117 C7 110 6 105 9 102 13 98 20 92 25 93 31 94 34 102 36 110 L41 134 C37 137 29 133 23 128 19 126 15 121 12 117Z",
      "M11 107 C7 100 8 96 12 91 17 87 22 85 26 88 32 92 34 100 35 107 L38 125 C34 128 27 125 22 122 17 118 14 112 11 107Z",
      "M45 101 C44 93 48 85 54 81 59 76 66 77 72 82 78 87 81 95 82 103 L81 115 C76 117 69 114 62 112 54 111 48 106 45 101Z",
      "M8 95 C5 89 5 83 9 80 13 76 18 72 22 74 28 77 30 85 31 93 L34 115 C30 118 22 115 17 111 13 108 10 101 8 95Z",
      "M29 120 C26 113 29 107 35 103 40 99 45 97 49 100 57 104 61 111 63 119 L65 137 C60 140 52 136 45 133 38 130 32 125 29 120Z"
    ],
    "hand-right-shape": [
      "M140 112 C137 105 140 97 144 92 146 89 147 83 149 80 151 76 155 77 158 80 162 84 166 81 170 86 175 90 177 98 173 103 167 111 158 116 151 118 146 120 142 117 140 112Z",
      "M196 106 C194 101 197 94 201 89 205 85 208 81 209 77 210 73 213 72 216 76 220 79 223 83 225 87 228 93 224 99 220 103 216 108 210 112 204 114 200 114 197 111 196 106Z",
      "M169 137 C167 131 169 125 174 120 178 116 181 113 183 109 185 105 188 104 192 107 198 111 201 110 205 117 209 123 206 129 201 133 194 138 186 143 178 145 174 146 171 143 169 137Z",
      "M158 124 C156 118 158 110 163 105 167 102 169 97 171 93 174 88 178 89 181 92 185 96 190 96 193 102 197 108 194 113 190 118 184 124 174 130 166 132 162 133 159 130 158 124Z",
      "M198 106 C196 101 198 94 202 89 205 85 208 81 209 77 210 73 213 72 216 76 220 79 223 83 225 87 228 93 224 98 220 103 216 108 210 111 204 113 201 113 199 111 198 106Z",
      "M153 126 C151 120 154 113 158 108 161 105 163 100 165 97 167 93 172 92 175 96 179 100 184 98 187 104 191 109 193 115 188 121 182 127 172 132 164 134 159 135 155 132 153 126Z",
      "M193 126 C191 120 194 112 199 107 202 103 205 99 207 94 208 90 212 89 215 93 219 97 222 99 224 104 227 110 223 117 219 122 214 128 206 133 200 134 196 134 194 131 193 126Z"
    ]
  };

  // Head position and roll, followed by torso position, width, height and lean.
  const bodyPoses = [
    [0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 1, 0],
    [1.1, -.5, 10, -.4, 1.006, 1.009, .013],
    [1.3, 4.2, 1.2, 0, 1.002, .989, -.004],
    [-.4, 10.3, 7.6, .7, 1.001, .956, .009],
    [1.2, 5.8, 7.2, .4, 1.001, .976, .005],
    [-.2, 1.5, -.5, .1, 1.006, .996, -.004],
    [.2, 5.7, 10.3, -.3, 1.001, .979, .011],
    [1.4, 10.5, 2.2, .8, 1.008, .952, -.007]
  ];

  function makeCurve(rows) {
    const count = rows.length;
    const slopes = rows.map((row, index) => {
      const prev = rows[(index + count - 1) % count];
      const next = rows[(index + 1) % count];
      const before = index ? times[index] - times[index - 1] : duration - times[count - 1];
      const after = times[index + 1] - times[index];
      const w1 = 2 * after + before;
      const w2 = after + 2 * before;
      return row.map((value, column) => {
        const a = (value - prev[column]) / before;
        const b = (next[column] - value) / after;
        return a * b > 0 ? (w1 + w2) / (w1 / a + w2 / b) : 0;
      });
    });
    return (index, next, basis) => rows[index].map((value, column) =>
      basis[0] * value + basis[1] * slopes[index][column] +
      basis[2] * rows[next][column] + basis[3] * slopes[next][column]
    );
  }

  const bodyCurve = makeCurve(bodyPoses);
  let parts;
  let head;
  let torso;

  window.nwb = {
    render(t) {
      if (!parts) {
        head = document.getElementById("head");
        torso = document.getElementById("torso");
        parts = Object.entries(wingPoses).map(([id, poses]) => {
          const element = document.getElementById(id);
          const template = element.getAttribute("d");
          const rows = [template, ...poses].map(path => path.match(number).map(Number));
          return { element, template, curve: makeCurve(rows) };
        });
      }

      const time = ((t % duration) + duration) % duration;
      let index = 0;
      while (time >= times[index + 1]) index++;
      const next = (index + 1) % bodyPoses.length;
      const span = times[index + 1] - times[index];
      const u = (time - times[index]) / span;
      const u2 = u * u;
      const u3 = u2 * u;
      const basis = [
        2 * u3 - 3 * u2 + 1,
        (u3 - 2 * u2 + u) * span,
        3 * u2 - 2 * u3,
        (u3 - u2) * span
      ];

      const [x, y, roll, shift, width, height, lean] = bodyCurve(index, next, basis);
      head.setAttribute("transform", `translate(${x} ${y}) rotate(${roll} 124 23)`);
      torso.setAttribute("transform",
        `translate(${124 + shift} 240) matrix(${width} 0 ${lean} ${height} 0 0) translate(-124 -240)`);

      for (const part of parts) {
        const values = part.curve(index, next, basis);
        let column = 0;
        part.element.setAttribute("d", part.template.replace(number, () => values[column++].toFixed(3)));
      }
    }
  };
})();
</script>
